mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as corporate earnings face demand contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0.5% qoq) and housing starts expansion (HOUST > 1350k) indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days via earnings acceleration.
failure_condition: The joint GDPC1 and HOUST signal fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 5.0% YoY triggers central bank rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days due to rising discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days as earnings growth stalls.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 fails to predict negative returns in more than 45% of cases over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 0.5% MoM signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent retail sales growth (RSAFS > 0.3% MoM) and housing starts expansion (HOUST > 1350k) indicate accelerating consumer confidence, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint RSAFS and HOUST signal fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate increases exceeding 0.5pp in 3 months signal aggressive monetary tightening, raising discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 3 months over 2-year windows.
